comparisons.peer_topic: Defense-in-Depth Security Strategy and Technical Controls
comparisons.peer_summary: Citi employs a threat-focused, defense-in-depth strategy utilizing a mature program that includes an internal intelligence center, industry participation, vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection, firewalls, and encryption. These logical, physical, and technical controls are designed to prevent, deter, mitigate, and respond to cybersecurity threats.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Citi describe specific threat intelligence and vulnerability management mechanisms as part of their cybersecurity defense. MS explicitly states its threat intelligence function leverages commercial and proprietary products to collect industry/governmental information, which informs risk assessments, while its internal detection and vulnerability management teams review external incidents. Similarly, Citi describes a mature program that includes an internal cybersecurity intelligence center, participation in industry/government information-sharing programs, and vulnerability assessment/scanning tools to prevent, deter, and mitigate threats. Both leverage external information sharing and internal vulnerability scanning/intelligence centers, though MS focuses on the flow from intelligence to strategy implementation, while Citi emphasizes the 'defense-in-depth' architecture of multiple controls working in tandem.

sentences.text: Our threat intelligence function within the Cybersecurity Program actively engages in private and public information-sharing communities and leverages both commercial and proprietary products to collect a wide variety of industry and governmental information regarding the latest cybersecurity threats, which informs our cybersecurity risk assessments and strategy.
Our vulnerability management team, as well as NFR, also reviews external cybersecurity incidents that may be relevant to the Firm to further inform the design of our Cybersecurity Program.

Citi leverages a threat-focused, defense-in-depth strategy that ensures that multiple controls work in tandem against various threats to increase the likelihood that malicious activity will be prevented, detected and mitigated.

Citi has a mature cybersecurity threat identification and management program that relies on an industry-aligned, risk-based, defense-in-depth approach, including an internal cybersecurity intelligence center, participation in industry and government information-sharing programs, vulnerability assessment and scanning tools, intrusion detection and prevention systems, security incident and event management systems, firewalls, penetration testing, adversary emulation exercises, data management (including classification, encryption at rest and in transit, and access management), multi-factor authentication requirements and other logical, physical and technical controls designed to prevent, deter, mitigate and respond to cybersecurity threats.

comparisons.peer_topic: CISO responsibilities and Technology Risk team functions
comparisons.peer_summary: The CISO manages and implements the Cybersecurity Program, reporting directly to the CIO. The CISO oversees the Technology Risk team, which assesses and manages material cybersecurity risks, sets control requirements, assesses adherence, and oversees incident detection and response. CISO and Technology Risk personnel have substantial expertise in information security and cybersecurity risk management.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and Goldman Sachs disclose the role of specialized internal teams in managing cybersecurity threats, specifically regarding the oversight of defense strategies and risk assessment. MS details that its internal cyber threat detection team and vulnerability management team review external incidents and implement defense strategies based on threat intelligence. Goldman Sachs describes its Technology Risk team, overseen by the CISO, which 'assesses and manages material risks from cybersecurity threats' and 'oversees incident detection and response.' Both entities utilize dedicated internal functional teams (detection/vulnerability at MS; Technology Risk at GS) to actively assess risks and manage incident response capabilities.

sentences.text: This information is also provided to an internal cyber threat detection team, which develops and implements strategies designed to defend against these cybersecurity threats across our environment.
Our vulnerability management team, as well as NFR, also reviews external cybersecurity incidents that may be relevant to the Firm to further inform the design of our Cybersecurity Program.

Our CISO oversees our Technology Risk team, which assesses and manages material risks from cybersecurity threats, sets firmwide control requirements, assesses adherence to controls, and oversees incident detection and response.
